items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Cuttrell was on the board. Oh yeah.

ctx.x: So, it seems like you would have gotten a lot of support for doing music, for playing

music. I had a lot of support from a lot of older musicians, like I tell you. I met a lot of them. A lot of them in that neighborhood where I lived and so forth. And by Mr. Houston coming to the house a lot of time when I'm in my junior year of high school, about 1949 to 50, is when he said, I give you permission to go in on and play. Well the union thing was just getting big then too. Union musicians couldn't play with the non-union musicians and all that kind of stuff. But if you join the union, it didn't cost…
